presets.name: Ticket stub
presets.what: A mustard roll ticket split by a perforated seam: ADMIT ONE on one side, a red serial stub on the other, heavy condensed caps.
presets.not: Not a die-cut sticker: flat printed card torn along a dotted perforation, serial numbers, no glossy border.

presets.name: Dymo label tape
presets.what: Strips of glossy black, red and blue plastic tape with white raised capitals punched in by a label maker, stuck on grey steel.
presets.not: Not a pill-button UI: each strip is a stamped plastic label with raised letters and a dent shadow, not a rounded control.

presets.name: Large-letter postcard
presets.what: Big blocky extruded capitals on linen-textured card, a script 'Greetings from', saturated sky blue and sunset orange, white border.
presets.not: Not seventies groovy: flat printed linen card with a white border and extruded block caps, not swirly rainbow lettering.

presets.name: Spot-colour swatch book
presets.what: A fanned deck of spot-colour chips: big solid ink panels on white stock, small mono ink numbers, coated and uncoated tags.
presets.not: Not colour blocking: the colours are specimen chips in a fanned guide with ink numbers, not a layout split into fields.

presets.name: Keynote hero
presets.what: One oversized device floats on a pure-black stage under soft light, huge tight white headline, a single blue accent, nothing else.
presets.not: Not dark gradient SaaS: no glow or colour wash; the product sits alone on true black, lit like a physical object.

presets.name: Dark gradient SaaS
presets.what: Near-black canvas, app windows lit by a violet gradient glow, hairline borders, tight grey-white type, fine noise.
presets.not: Not keynote hero: the light comes from gradient glows and hairlines inside the UI, not a spotlit object.

presets.name: Light editorial SaaS
presets.what: Crisp white page, deep navy type set like a magazine with rules and columns, one saturated gradient block, generous whitespace.
presets.not: Not calm productivity: sharp, grid-led and gradient-accented, not warm paper and slow serif calm.

presets.name: Bento showcase
presets.what: Features packed into a tight grid of rounded white tiles on light grey, each tile one stat, icon or screenshot, revealed in sequence.
presets.not: Not dashboard showcase: tiles are curated feature moments, not live metrics.

presets.name: Floating-card UI
presets.what: The interface broken into independent white cards hovering over a pale tinted field, deep soft drop shadows, cards drifting at different depths.
presets.not: Not bento: cards float freely at depth with parallax, not locked into a grid.

presets.name: Exploded UI
presets.what: One app window separates into stacked offset layers, each edged in a bright accent, revealing its structure like an exploded technical view.
presets.not: Not deconstructed UI: layers stay aligned on one axis; nothing is scattered.

presets.name: Oversized UI
presets.what: A single toggle, cursor or button blown up to poster scale on a saturated field, filling the frame like a graphic shape.
presets.not: Not component spec close-up: scale is the joke here; the control becomes a poster graphic, not a measured detail.

presets.name: Command-palette UI
presets.what: A single floating search bar on a dim canvas, keystrokes typing in, results snapping into place beside key-cap glyphs.

presets.name: Dashboard showcase
presets.what: A clean light analytics view: one hero line chart in a white panel, a big KPI number, faint grid, calm blue-and-green series.
presets.not: Not dark ops dashboard: bright product-marketing polish with one hero chart, not a dense wall of metrics.

presets.name: App Store promo
presets.what: A phone floats on a warm peach field, glossy 3D icons and rating stickers pop around it, each screen springing into place.
presets.not: Not calm productivity: loud, sticker-happy and springy where that one is quiet and slow.

presets.name: Browser-framed UI
presets.what: The product shown inside tidy browser windows with traffic-light chrome on a dotted neutral backdrop, cursor-led, soft realistic shadows.

presets.name: Component spec close-up
presets.what: One button, toggle or input magnified on a dark dot grid with crosshair registration marks, hairline outlines, measured motion.
presets.not: Not oversized UI: a measured close-up with spec marks, not a poster-scale gag.

presets.name: Fintech trust
presets.what: Brushed-metal card surfaces over warm stone, deep navy serif headlines, one money-green accent; calm, weighty, nothing flashy.
presets.not: Not luxury: it still shows real balances and cards; restraint serves trust, not status.

presets.name: Terminal product demo
presets.what: Pure-black stage, one crisp terminal window with a hairline border, monospace commands typing in, a single mint success glow.
presets.not: Not financial terminal: sparse, modern and glowing, not a dense amber data screen.

presets.name: Developer docs
presets.what: A light documentation page: white canvas, grey code blocks with hairline borders, blue links, monospace snippets, tidy and literal.
presets.not: Not terminal product demo: bright and instructional; it teaches the code rather than shows off the tool.

presets.name: AI chat product
presets.what: Prompt bars and answer bubbles on a warm off-white page, text streaming in, a violet-to-cyan sparkle marking the AI.

presets.name: Calm productivity
presets.what: A phone app on warm paper, serif headline, soft neutral rows, one gentle ochre accent, slow unhurried dissolves.

presets.name: Widget-first UI
presets.what: Chunky rounded widgets on a dark home-screen field: vivid colour tiles, big glanceable numbers, glossy 3D icons springing in.
presets.not: Not bento showcase: dark, native and toy-bright; tiles are live widgets, not marketing panels.

presets.name: Automotive HMI
presets.what: A charcoal cockpit screen with thin cyan gauges and rings, condensed uppercase readouts, restrained glow: shipping hardware, not sci-fi.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: fewer brackets, no noise or glitch; every gauge reads like a real product.

presets.name: Node canvas
presets.what: Rounded nodes wired by dashed connectors on a dotted infinite canvas, data pulses travelling link to link.
presets.not: Not systems diagram: it is the product's own editable canvas, with cursors and drag, not an explanatory figure.

presets.name: Deconstructed UI
presets.what: A familiar screen broken into its buttons, cards and labels, scattered at angles with tape and hard shadows, then snapping back together.
presets.not: Not exploded UI: pieces scatter freely and rotate; there is no single stacking axis.

presets.name: Spatial glass UI
presets.what: Frosted translucent panels hover over a deep blurred colour field, soft light edges, gentle parallax depth.
presets.not: Not floating-card UI: panels are see-through glass in dark space, not opaque white cards on a pale field.

presets.name: Wireframe UI
presets.what: Grey boxes, dashed outlines and placeholder bars on a faint grid: the product sketched as structure before pixels.
presets.not: Not blueprint schematic: neutral greys and UI placeholders, not white-on-blue technical drawing.

presets.name: Windows 95
presets.what: Grey beveled windows with navy title bars and square _ □ × buttons on a teal desktop, pixel type and chunky pixel icons.
presets.not: Not vaporwave: the OS here is played straight, no pink gradients, busts or irony.

presets.name: Classic Mac 1-bit
presets.what: Pure black-and-white 1-bit desktop: dithered grey pattern, square windows with hard black drop shadows, bitmap type.
presets.not: Not Windows 95: no colour and no bevels; every pixel is black or white and depth is a hard drop shadow.

presets.name: Windows XP Luna
presets.what: Glossy royal-blue title bars and rounded window tops over a Bliss-sky gradient, cheerful green accents and soft drop shadows.
presets.not: Not Windows 95: XP is colourful, glossy and rounded where 95 is grey and square.

presets.name: Mac OS X Aqua
presets.what: Glossy blue gel pill buttons with wet highlights on pale pinstripe grey, lozenge controls and soft shadows.
use: app launches with a nostalgic wink
presets.not: Not Y2K chrome: Aqua is translucent blue gel and pinstripes, not silver metal and sparkles.

presets.name: Y2K chrome
presets.what: Liquid-silver chrome cards and wide techno type on icy blue, pink and cyan highlights, four-point sparkles everywhere.
presets.not: Not Frutiger Aero: Y2K is metallic and techno; Aero is glassy, sky-blue and nature-clean.

presets.name: Frutiger Aero
presets.what: Glossy translucent glass tiles over sky blue and grass green, bubbles and light blooms, clean humanist sans.
presets.not: Not modern glassmorphism: Aero is saturated sky-and-grass, glossy highlights and bubbles, not muted frosted panels.

presets.name: Vaporwave
aka: A E S T H E T I C
presets.what: Pastel pink-to-cyan collage of old OS windows and cut-out scraps, wide-spaced serif caps, scanlines and a perspective grid.
presets.not: Not synthwave: vaporwave is pastel, ironic and collaged; synthwave is dark, neon and sincere.

presets.name: Synthwave
presets.what: Hot-pink and cyan neon tube type glowing over a dark purple night, a perspective laser grid and sunset rays.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: synthwave is 80s sunset nostalgia; cyberpunk is gritty, dystopian and data-heavy.

presets.name: 70s groovy
presets.what: Fat swashy bubble type in orange, mustard and brown on warm cream, sunburst rays and a soft film grain.
presets.not: Not 60s mid-century: groovy is fat, curvy and warm-brown; mid-century is geometric, atomic and flat.

presets.name: Mid-century modern
presets.what: Flat teal, mustard and tomato shapes in a loose editorial grid, atomic starbursts, geometric sans and printed grain.
presets.not: Not 70s groovy: mid-century is flat, angular and restrained, with atomic stars instead of fat curves.

presets.name: Art deco
presets.what: Gold double rules and sunburst fans on deep green-black, symmetrical centred layout, tall geometric display caps.
presets.not: Not luxury minimal: deco is ornamental, symmetrical and gold-lined, not quiet whitespace.

presets.name: 8-bit pixel art
presets.what: Chunky pixel icons, blocky arcade type and hard square shadows on a flat sky-blue, tiled like a game menu.
presets.not: Not Game Boy: 8-bit is full NES colour; Game Boy is four shades of green.

presets.name: Game Boy green
presets.what: Four shades of pea-soup green only, a handheld screen frame, pixel type and an LCD dot grid.
presets.not: Not 8-bit pixel art: strictly four greens, like the original LCD, no full colour.

presets.name: Green-screen CRT terminal
presets.what: Glowing phosphor-green monospace on black, curved-tube vignette, scanlines, a blinking block cursor typing line by line.
presets.not: Not a modern terminal UI: the whole frame is the old tube, with glow, curvature and scanlines.

presets.name: DOS text mode
presets.what: White and yellow monospace on electric DOS blue, boxy text-mode panels with double-line borders, square and flat.
presets.not: Not the green CRT: text mode is flat, blue and panel-based with no glow or tube curvature.

presets.name: Teletext
presets.what: Eight flat broadcast colours on black, blocky mosaic charts and bars, pixel headline bands, no curves anywhere.
presets.not: Not 8-bit game art: teletext is a flat information page in eight fixed colours, not sprites.

presets.name: VHS camcorder
presets.what: On-screen-display readouts like PLAY and a timestamp over dim tape footage, tracking scanlines, RGB split and glitch jumps.
presets.not: Not film grain cinema: this is consumer tape, with OSD text, colour bleed and tracking errors.

presets.name: Early iPhone skeuomorphism
presets.what: Glossy app icons and brushed-metal bars in a phone, linen-textured backgrounds, embossed type and soft realistic shadows.
presets.not: Not neumorphism: this imitates real materials (metal, linen, glass), not soft extruded plastic.

presets.name: 90s rave flyer
presets.what: Acid yellow, magenta and cyan on black, shaded 3D display type, halftone dots and stacked colour offsets in dense tiles.
presets.not: Not synthwave: rave flyers are fluoro, dense and xeroxed, not smooth neon sunsets.

presets.name: 70s airline modernism
presets.what: Crisp grotesk on cream, bold red and navy stripes, route-map nodes and connectors, orderly Swiss-grid information design.
presets.not: Not modern Swiss minimal: warm cream paper, livery stripes and jet-age optimism, not white SaaS.

presets.name: Web 1.0 homepage
presets.what: Times headings and bright yellow text on a starry navy tile, beveled table borders, hit-counter energy and pixel GIF icons.
presets.not: Not vaporwave: Web 1.0 is sincere amateur HTML, not a pastel ironic collage.

presets.name: Space-age retro-futurism
presets.what: Rounded cream cards orbited by elliptical atom rings, boomerang-orange and teal, bouncy rounded display type.
presets.not: Not synthwave: this is the 1950s imagining tomorrow, cream daylight and atoms, not 80s neon night.

presets.name: Lab notebook
presets.what: A bound lab-notebook page: faint quad grid, ballpoint-blue hand lettering, dated numbered entries ruled off, one red-pen correction.
presets.not: Not doodle notebook or bullet journal: a working record, dated and numbered in ballpoint on quad grid, no doodles or stickers.

presets.name: Patent drawing
presets.what: Black ink line art on bright white: a device drawn in isometric, grey-shaded faces, reference numerals and a lettered FIG. 1; no colour.
presets.not: Not a blueprint: black line on white with no grid or blue ground; parts are shaded grey and carry reference numerals.

presets.name: Engineering drawing
presets.what: A drafting sheet: black linework on white film, a round part in front view with centre lines, dimension callouts, border frame and red markup.
presets.not: Not blueprint: black line on white drafting film, not white on blue; dimensioned and framed like a real CAD sheet.

presets.name: Topographic survey map
presets.what: A survey quad: brown contour lines, woodland-green land tint, blue water, a red trail between pins, compass, scale bar and fine sans lettering.
presets.not: Not a map explainer: a surveyor's sheet with contours, land tints and a scale bar, not bold news markers on a dot grid.

presets.name: Celestial atlas
presets.what: An engraved star-atlas plate: midnight-blue ground, pale-gold star points and double-ruled frame, a cartouche title in Fell small caps.
presets.not: Not orbital space: an antique engraved plate with gold rules and star points, not a black void with orbit paths.

presets.name: Histology stain (H&E)
presets.what: Stained tissue under glass: eosin-pink and haematoxylin-violet cell blobs washing a slide-white field, frosted panels and clean lab sans.
presets.not: Not organic biomorphic: the blobs are stained cells on a glass slide in eosin pink and haematoxylin violet, labelled like a lab.

presets.name: Radiology viewer (MRI)
presets.what: A radiology workstation: greyscale scan panes on black, DICOM corner text, fine noise, and one hot-orange false-colour signal.
presets.not: Not a dark ops dashboard: greyscale scan panes and corner metadata; colour appears only where the false-colour signal is.

presets.name: Periodic table
presets.what: Square element cells on white, hairline black rules, big symbols with small numbers, category colours: metal yellow, gas blue.
presets.not: Not bento showcase: a strict chart of equal square cells, ruled and colour-coded by category, not rounded product tiles.

presets.name: Nautical chart
presets.what: A hydrographic chart: pale-blue water, buff land, a magenta course line and notes, graticule ticks and an upright serif title.
presets.not: Not a topographic survey: the sea is the subject, pale blue with magenta navigation notes; the land is left blank buff.

presets.name: Seismograph record
presets.what: A drum-recorder sheet: black trace on white graph paper, red time marks, one magnitude set huge and a station code in mono.
presets.not: Not metric count-up: a paper instrument record, black on grid with red time marks, not a bold marketing number.

presets.name: Flight checklist
presets.what: A sixties space-program procedures card: off-white stock, black geometric caps, numbered steps with boxed crew codes and a safety-orange mark.
presets.not: Not mission control: the printed card the crew holds, black caps on paper and a checklist, not glowing screens.

presets.name: Spectroscopy
presets.what: White light split by a prism across a black bench: fine spectral beams, one sodium-yellow line measured huge in nanometres, mono read-outs.
presets.not: Not holographic iridescent: a physics bench with a prism and one measured spectral line on black, not a shimmering foil surface.

presets.name: Museum specimen label
presets.what: A specimen drawer: cream typewritten labels with fine black borders on dark cabinet green, catalogue numbers and a red type-specimen tag.
presets.not: Not archival documentary: small typed labels in a cabinet drawer, catalogue-numbered, not sepia photos panned on paper.

presets.name: Geologic time scale
presets.what: The stratigraphic chart: period names on an axis in millions of years, stone-white ground, strata-green progress and plain sans.
presets.not: Not a timeline explainer: deep time in millions of years with named periods and stratigraphic colour, no product milestones.

presets.name: Skew-T sounding
presets.what: A meteorologist's sounding chart: fine grid on white, a red temperature trace and green dashed dewpoint, pressure in hPa, plain condensed labels.
presets.not: Not data journalism: an instrument chart from meteorology, grid-led with red and green traces, no newsroom serif or furniture.

presets.name: Collider event display
presets.what: A detector cross-section on black: concentric grey barrel rings, curling yellow particle tracks, cyan energy deposits, run and event numbers.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi HUD: a real detector read-out, rings and curling tracks on black with no glow, brackets or targeting.

presets.name: Card catalogue
presets.what: A typed library card lifted from an oak drawer: cream stock, call number, all-caps typewriter heading and indented entries.
presets.not: Not a screenplay page: a small catalogue card on oak, call number and entries, not a script on a bare page.

presets.name: Material You

presets.name: Marshmallow 3D flat

presets.name: Pastel minimal

presets.name: Soft flow diagram

presets.name: Liquid glass
presets.what: Clear lens-like glass controls on a vivid coral-to-cobalt wallpaper, bright rim light and glow, surfaces that ripple and morph.

presets.name: Nordic soft
